from: the online safety / Grade 9 SQL planning chat
why: The Grade 9 intro to SQL course (the rhino case, AIResources/courses/sql9-course.md): scenes, landscapes and animals as realistic coloured-pencil drawings beside the ops-room data figures. Chris, 9 October 2026: 'more realistic coloured pencil sketches of scenes, landscape, animals, etc.' and the oxpecker mascot 'ox - but more realistic drawings'. Style: AIResources/brand/sql9-art-style.md. No lesson waits on these: each lesson shows its ops-room figure alone until the picture exists.
style: realistic coloured pencil drawing on warm off-white paper, visible pencil strokes and paper texture, natural colours, soft Limpopo bushveld light, wildlife field-guide illustration, no text, no letters, no logos
